F1: Override availability returns before busy-time validation, allowing conflicting bookings and calendar events to remain bookable.
F2: The predicate rejects a slot outside any one working-hours interval and calculates its end from its start time.
F3: A same-day override that excludes a slot rejects it even when another override interval contains it.
F4: Extracting only converted hours and minutes loses midnight rollover, causing cross-day override availability to be dropped.
